props.name: filter
props.comment: Client-side filter for the resolved list.

props.name: perPage
props.comment: Client-side page size for the resolved list.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to read the FK array off. Defaults to the ambient record.

props.name: reference
props.comment: The referenced resource the ids point at (e.g. `"tags"`). A registered resource name.

props.name: sort
props.comment: Client-side sort for the resolved list.

props.name: source
props.comment: The FK-array field on the current record (e.g. `"tag_ids"`).
